exposure: place of delivery (health center vs hospital)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 335 women who had recently delivered at eight healthcare facilities in Musanze District, Rwanda, between March and May 2024.
finding: The proportion of respectful maternity care in Musanze District was 65.1%, with employment, primiparity, cesarean delivery, delivery at health centers, daytime delivery, and non-Rwanda's Community Based Health Insurance associated with higher odds of receiving RMC.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were associated with a greater likelihood of receiving respectful maternity care compared to those who delivered vaginally.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between March and May 2024.
